Sternjagd Rules

Chase the others over the board with one die and take their stars; the last player with stars left wins.

The basics

Board
The board has twelve fields joined by arrows: four corners, four circles on the edges and four circles inside. Two arrows leave every field. The corners are the start fields.
Your turn
Roll the die and move your piece exactly that many steps, each step along one arrow. You choose the way. Every field where such a route can end is shown with a ring; tap one. You must move if you can, but you may not end on the field you started from.
Catching
If your move ends on a field with an opponent's piece, you catch it: it loses one star and goes back to a free start corner. Passing over a piece changes nothing.
Stars
Everyone starts with three stars. Whoever has no star left is out of the game.
Winning
The last player left wins. If nobody has won after 600 moves, the game is a draw.
Who starts
The player who starts is drawn at the beginning of every game, because moving first is a small advantage.
The computer
The computer catches whenever it can. Otherwise it picks the field where opponents are least likely to hit it on their next turn.
Undo
Undo takes back your last move, also against the computer. The die keeps the number it showed.
